A '''clan''' of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was known for wearing [[Armor/Legends|armor]] made from the hide of the [[Zakkeg/Legends|zakkeg]] beast. They often went on zakkeg hunts, and occasionally allowed outsiders to accompany them.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Hunting the Zakkeg}}</ref>
